PaymentAdmin.providerInfo: Choose the company that will process your store's payments.
PaymentAdmin.mercadopagoDesc: recommended if you plan to use Pix, boleto, or credit card, in full or installments.
PaymentAdmin.providerNote: You need to create an account with the chosen provider before continuing.
PaymentAdmin.stripePublicKeyInfo: To use Stripe, follow these steps:
PaymentAdmin.stripePublicKeyStep: Log in and go to Developers > API Keys. Copy the Publishable Key and enter it in this field.
PaymentAdmin.mercadopagoPublicKeyInfo: To use Mercado Pago, follow these steps:
PaymentAdmin.mercadopagoStep1: Create an account at Mercado Pago Developers.
PaymentAdmin.mercadopagoStep2: Log in, go to Your Integrations, then click Criar aplicação.
PaymentAdmin.mercadopagoStep3: Choose: Criar no painel de integração
PaymentAdmin.mercadopagoStep5: Op (Tipo de Api): Choose: Api de Orders
PaymentAdmin.mercadopagoStep6: In the side menu, go to Production Credentials and fill in your business area and website.
PaymentAdmin.mercadopagoStep7: Click Activate production credentials and copy the Public Key.
PaymentAdmin.stripePrivateKeyInfo: In the same place you copied your public key, copy the Secret Key and enter it in this field.
PaymentAdmin.mercadopagoAccessTokenInfo: In the same place you copied your public key, copy the Access Token and paste it in this field.
PaymentAdmin.webhookWarning: For payments to work correctly, you need to set up a webhook in Mercado Pago:
PaymentAdmin.webhookInstructions: Still in your Mercado Pago account dashboard, follow the steps below:
PaymentAdmin.webhookStep1: In the side menu, go to Webhooks.
PaymentAdmin.webhookStep2: Select Production mode (it defaults to test mode).
PaymentAdmin.webhookStep3: Copy the address shown in the field above and paste it into the Production URL field.
PaymentAdmin.webhookNote: Without this webhook, the system won't automatically receive payment notifications.
PaymentAdmin.mercadopagoWebhookSignatureInfo: In the same place where you pasted your webhook URL, copy the signature key and enter it in this field.
PaymentAdmin.accountDataPlaceholder: E.g.: Nubank, branch 0001, account 123456-7, Tax ID 123.456.789-00
PaymentAdmin.pixAccountDataPlaceholder: E.g.: key@email.com, MY STORE, SAO PAULO
PaymentAdmin.boletoAccountDataPlaceholder: E.g.: Bank 237, Branch 1234, Beneficiary Code 56789, Tax ID 12.345.678/0001-90
PaymentAdmin.accountDataHelp: Enter the complete transfer details: bank, branch, account, type, and the account holder's Tax ID.
PaymentAdmin.pixDataHelp: Enter the Pix details separated by hyphens, in this order: Pix Key, Payee, and City.
PaymentAdmin.pixDataInfoTip: Keep this exact order and separator — the QR Code parser depends on it.
PaymentAdmin.pixDataWarning: With Offline PIX, you'll need to verify the payment manually, as it doesn't go through a payment gateway.
